title: Added selector selectIsCartEmpty to the cart store

segments.title: Empty-cart selector added to the cart store
context: A shopper sees the same cart page as before: the empty message for a cart with no items, and the list with its total for every other cart. The cart store now gives the answer to whether the cart is empty, and the cart page reads that answer where it counted the items itself.
## Overview
- **When** a shopper opens the cart page with no items in the cart, **then** nothing changes: the page shows "Your cart is empty.".
- **When** a shopper opens the cart page with one or more items in the cart, **then** nothing changes: the page lists the items and the total.
- **When** a shopper confirms "Empty the cart?" on the cart page, **then** nothing changes: the page shows "Your cart is empty." in place of the list.
## Implementation
**`src/stores/cart-store.ts`**

- Added the function [`selectIsCartEmpty()`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#selectIsCartEmpty), which [returns `true` when `state.items` has length 0](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L33) and `false` for every other length.
**`src/routes/cart/index.tsx`**
- Modified [the import from `@/stores/cart-store`](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#L1) to name `selectIsCartEmpty` as well as `useCartStore`.

- Modified [``](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#CartPage) to [call `useCartStore(selectIsCartEmpty)`](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#L7) and to [return `

Your cart is empty.

` when the result is `true`](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#L8). It tested `items.length === 0` before.

journeyNodes.label: Shows the cart, or that the cart is empty
journeyNodes.description: When a shopper opens /cart, `router` in `src/router.tsx` renders this component as the `element` of its `cart` route.

journeyNodes.label: Returns `true` when the cart has no items
journeyNodes.description: When a shopper opens /cart, `<CartPage />` [passes this function to `useCartStore`](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#L7). [`useCartStore`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L11-22) is the hook that `create` of `zustand` returns. The call of this function with the state of the store is inside `zustand`, and no line of the repository calls it by name.

waypoints.title: Modified the cart store import to name `selectIsCartEmpty`
waypoints.reading: The author modified an import that now names `selectIsCartEmpty` as well as `useCartStore`, both from `@/stores/cart-store`. [`<CartPage />` passes `selectIsCartEmpty` to `useCartStore`](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#L7), and [`src/stores/cart-store.ts` declares `selectIsCartEmpty()`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#selectIsCartEmpty) in this pull request.

waypoints.title: Modified `<CartPage />` to test `isCartEmpty` before it returns the empty message
waypoints.reading:
The author modified a condition in the component `` that now tests `isCartEmpty`, where it tested `items.length === 0` before. `isCartEmpty` is the result of `useCartStore(selectIsCartEmpty)`, and [`selectIsCartEmpty()`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#selectIsCartEmpty) [returns `state.items.length === 0`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L33), so that `` returns `

Your cart is empty.

` for the same carts as before. `` still reads `items` from the store, because it renders one `` per item. `router` in `src/router.tsx` renders `` with no props, and `` still takes none.
waypoints.needsAttention: This is the one waypoint of the pull request where the code that runs is different: the first `return` now depends on the result of [`selectIsCartEmpty()`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#selectIsCartEmpty), and not on `items.length`. The other two waypoints declare that function and import it.
